kind: # Hand overrides for tools/rename_derive.py, which reads this file after
# docs/vocabulaire.md and lets it win. Kinds:
#   token     a token or a phrase (`zone_choisie`) inside any name
#   name      one whole name, wherever it is declared
#   field     `parent.name`: a field, local or parameter of that struct or function
#   identity  one declaration, by the identity of make rename-extract
# `=` as the new name keeps the old one (statut conservé).
# --- Vocabulary concepts whose row the parser cannot pair ------------------
# --- French test and helper names, translated whole ----------------------------
# --- long-scoped short locals and parameters, read in their function ---------
# A local whose derived name is that of a function, type or static it can see.
# A binary takes the name of its cmd/ file, except frames: tmp/frames is the
# folder of the e2e captures; the Makefile already calls it FRAMES_TOOL.
# frames_ref.sh builds the replay driver of an old commit in a worktree: it
# keeps the old name for a tree without the new rule, as it keeps src/main.c.

new: garde aussi tmp/pico8_replay pour un commit sans la règle tmp/replay
